title: 第23课 · 假期你打算怎么过
subtitle: Lesson 23 — 假期你打算怎么过 · How do you plan to spend the holiday

items.en: How do you plan to spend the holiday?
I plan to travel to Xi'an.
Where do you want to go for fun?
How do you celebrate Spring Festival?

items.zh: 全家人在一起吃年夜饭。
items.py: Quán jiā rén zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn.
items.en: The whole family eats New Year's Eve dinner together.

items.zh: 和子：快放假了。假期你打算怎么过？
items.py: Hézǐ: Kuài fàng jià le. Jiàqī nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme guò?
items.en: Hezi: The holiday is coming. How do you plan to spend it?

items.zh: 大卫：我打算去西安旅行。你呢？
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ dǎsuàn qù Xī'ān lǚxíng. Nǐ ne?
items.en: David: I plan to travel to Xi'an. You?

items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ xiǎng qù Shànghǎi kànkan.
items.en: Hezi: I want to go have a look at Shanghai.

items.py: Dàwèi: Yī ge rén qù ma?
Hézǐ: Bù, gēn tóngxué yīqǐ qù.
Dàwèi: Nǐmen dǎsuàn qù jǐ tiān?
items.en: David: How many days do you plan to go?

items.py: Dàwèi: Zhù nǐmen wán de gāoxìng!
items.en: David: Hope you have a great time!

items.zh: 玛丽：张老师，春节快到了吧？
items.py: Mǎlì: Zhāng lǎoshī, Chūnjié kuài dào le ba?
items.en: Mary: Teacher Zhang, Spring Festival is coming soon, right?

items.zh: 张老师：对，下个星期就是春节了。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Duì, xià ge xīngqī jiù shì Chūnjié le.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Yes, it's Spring Festival next week.
Mary: How do you celebrate Spring Festival?

items.zh: 张老师：全家人在一起吃年夜饭。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Quán jiā rén zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: The whole family eats New Year's Eve dinner together.

items.zh: 张老师：放鞭炮，看春晚，小孩子还有红包。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Fàng biānpào, kàn chūnwǎn, xiǎo háizi hái yǒu hóngbāo.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Set off firecrackers, watch the Spring Festival gala, kids get red envelopes.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (打算 / 想 Plans)

items.en: I plan to go to Xi'an. (打算 = definite plan)
I'd like to visit Shanghai. (想 = wish/desire)
When do you plan to leave?
What do you plan to do during the holiday?

items.zh: 假期你打算怎么过？——我打算去旅行。
items.py: Jiàqī nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme guò? —— Wǒ dǎsuàn qù lǚxíng.
items.en: How will you spend the holiday? — I plan to travel.

items.zh: 假期你打算怎么过？——我打算在家休息。
items.py: Jiàqī nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme guò? —— Wǒ dǎsuàn zài jiā xiūxi.
items.en: — I plan to rest at home.

items.zh: 假期你打算怎么过？——我打算去看朋友。
items.py: Jiàqī nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme guò? —— Wǒ dǎsuàn qù kàn péngyou.

items.zh: 你想去哪儿玩？——我想去成都。
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr wán? —— Wǒ xiǎng qù Chéngdū.
items.en: Where do you want to go? — Chengdu.

items.zh: 你想去哪儿玩？——我想去桂林。
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr wán? —— Wǒ xiǎng qù Guìlín.
items.en: Where do you want to go? — Guilin.
